messages:
erin: Noticed confusion in reviews: inline comments on regression diffs don't thread well when people reply quickly. Threads look flattened and reviewers lose context. Screenshot: https://redwood.mock/fig/diff-comments.png

erin: Problem details: replies are appended inline separated by small timestamps, not grouped. Also no visual marker when a comment has been resolved vs archived.

samir: Agreed. UX ask: introduce a compact thread view under each diff chunk (collapsed by default) showing '3 replies' which expands into a threaded view. Keeps the diff scanning dense.

dana: Accessibility: collapsed thread button needs aria-expanded and the number of unread replies should be announced. Use a sr-only text like '3 replies, collapsed'.

li: Microcopy: change 'Resolve' to 'Mark resolved' and add a secondary 'Archive' action for moderator-only cleanup. People thought 'Resolve' deleted the comment.

ux-bot: heuristic-scan: current inline reply input steals focus on expand which breaks keyboard flow. Recommend focus land on the first reply when expanded, not the input.

samir: Interaction idea: inline threads should support a small keyboard nav: 'r' to reply (opens input), 'o' to toggle resolved state on focused comment, and Enter to expand/collapse when focused on the thread line. Will need help doc.

dana: For screen readers: when a thread expands, announce 'Thread expanded: 3 replies. Last reply from Alex, 5 minutes ago.' Keep it concise. Use aria-live polite.

erin: Visual affordance: show a colored dot for unresolved threads, grey dot for resolved, and a timestamp cluster for latest activity. Add a small 'unread' badge when there are new replies since last visit.

li: There's also a permission nuance: suggestion edits vs comments. Add labels 'Suggestion' and 'Note' above each comment bubble so reviewers know actionable items.

samir: Implementation note: store thread metadata (resolved, unread_count, last_actor, kind) to avoid heavy DOM traversal. Also lazy-load replies when expanding.

dana: i18n: 'Mark resolved' vs 'Resolve' translations differ. @i18n-bot flagged. Need separate keys and context notes.

i18n-bot: i18n-scan: flagged. Use keys `comment.mark_resolved` and `comment.resolve_confirm` with translator notes about moderation differences.

erin: Confirmation copy for marking resolved: 'Mark this thread resolved? This will hide it from default view but can be reopened.' CTA: 'Mark resolved' / 'Cancel'. Keep short.

ux-bot: accessibility checklist: aria-expanded on thread toggle, aria-live on expansion summary, focus management (don't auto-focus input), and keyboard shortcuts discoverable in a help tooltip.

samir: For bulk workflows: allow users to 'Mark all replies in view as resolved' with a confirmation when count > 20. Useful for large sweep after triage.

dana: Edge case: if a thread has unresolved suggestions, require a confirm explaining suggestions are pending. Add a small inline note linking to change requests.

erin: Decision summary: collapsed thread view by default, thread toggle with aria-expanded and aria-live summary, reply keyboard shortcut 'r', mark resolved -> 'Mark resolved' + confirm, unread badge, lazy-load replies, labels for 'Suggestion' vs 'Note', bulk resolve action for >20 with confirm, and i18n keys updated.

li: Action items: @samir prototype the collapsed thread UI + keyboard help, @dana add aria-live text and confirm copy, @erin update product spec and include bulk threshold, @i18n-bot create translation keys.

erin: Thanks all 44d. Please tag me on the PR and include a short demo GIF.
